name: commission math
description: Place a KES 10,000 order and verify the marketplace records a 15% Vaa commission and KES 8,500 brand earnings.
expected: The order is saved with KES 1,500 commission and KES 8,500 brand earnings.

name: brand signup dashboard access
description: Create a new Vaa account using the Brand signup option and verify the account receives brand owner access and opens the dashboard.
steps: Verify the For brands workspace opens
expected: The brand signup creates brand owner access and the user is automatically taken to the Vaa for brands dashboard.

name: empty marketplace storefront
description: Verify the customer-facing storefront starts with no seeded products or brands.
expected: The Shop page shows 0 pieces with no product cards, and the Brands page shows no brand cards.

name: product image upload and storefront rendering
description: Upload a real product image from the brand product manager and verify the product is saved with its image visible in the storefront.
steps: Enter a product name and price
Open Shop and inspect the new product image
expected: The image file is uploaded, the product is saved, and the uploaded image is visible on the customer storefront.

name: signed-in account menu
description: Verify a signed-in user sees the polished user icon account menu and available account actions.
expected: The user icon opens an account menu showing the account role and sign-out action, with role dashboard access when applicable.
